metrics.name: oracle_ingest_latency_ms
metrics.description: End-to-end elapsed wall time for validating one offline baseline batch in the oracle validation bridge script.
notes: This is an offline bridge/baseline metric, not the node runtime hot-path ingest latency.
Bench mode derives p50/p95/max from repeated runs of the same producer.

metrics.name: oracle_stale_reject_total
metrics.description: Number of snapshots rejected because at least one required source timestamp exceeded the staleness bound.

metrics.name: oracle_quorum_reject_total
metrics.description: Number of snapshots rejected because unique canonicalized sources were below the minimum quorum.

metrics.name: oracle_drift_reject_total
metrics.description: Number of snapshots rejected because any source deviated from the median beyond the configured deviation threshold.

metrics.name: oracle_source_cardinality
metrics.description: Maximum canonicalized source cardinality observed among accepted snapshots in a baseline run.
notes: This intentionally uses the max accepted source cardinality so late smaller accepted samples do not overwrite a stronger earlier signal.

metrics.name: accepted_total
metrics.description: Number of snapshots accepted by the baseline validator.

metrics.name: sample_count
metrics.description: Total number of snapshots processed by the baseline validator.

bench_outputs.name: bench_rounds
bench_outputs.description: Requested number of benchmark rounds executed for the offline oracle metrics benchmark entrypoint.

bench_outputs.name: bench_count
bench_outputs.description: Requested per-round iteration count executed by the offline oracle metrics benchmark entrypoint.

invariants: Metric names are append-stable and must not be renamed without a contract version bump.
Reject counters are mutually exclusive for a single snapshot in the current bridge implementation.
